remarks: Discover this remarkable private retreat nestled amid mature trees and stunning walled gardens. This meticulously maintained home offers a serene escape on a private, landscaped property. Inside, enjoy beautiful wide plank oak flooring and an open plan layout that seamlessly connects the gourmet kitchen, equipped with top-of- the-line Sub-Zero and Thermador appliances, with the dining and living areas, creating a warm and comfortable flow. French doors open to a spectacular outdoor entertainment area featuring a pool, separate spa and built in gas bbq. Additional highlights include a spacious wood-paneled first-floor office, a 2nd floor TV room with sauna and a spacious finished lower level ideal for play room or home gym. Compelling expansion or renovation possibilities
